name: smwmusic-treasure-conflix-battle-field
title: Treasure Conflix - Battle Field
description:
My personal favorite song in Treasure Conflix.

This song has a define for whether or not you want to have the sound effect at the start from the Zophar's Domain SPC (I felt like it could be useful), the define has options for lower echo or the original echo.

Note: If you are using the original echo, the following samples will be omitted:

09 SMW @7.brr (Steel Drum; Bonus end)
0F SMW @21.brr (Kick)
10 SMW @12.brr (Conga; Bonus End)
11 SMW @17.brr (Distorted Guitar)
13 SMW Thunder.brr (Thunder, Blarggs, Castle Blowing up, Valley of Bowser shaking)
